To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the PAI curriculum does not contain much content that aims at inculcating co-existence and peace education; about one third of the teachers and students reported intolerant attitudes towards other religions; the project was successful in developing a peace education curriculum based on Islam that aims to develop a peaceful character among young people through the teaching of mutual respect, non-violence, social justice and co-existence, using Islamic values.

1. the curriculum of PAI in the four schools in this study does not have enough content that aims to inculcate co-existence and peace education; 2. around one-third of the teachers and students report non-tolerant attitudes towards other religions; 3. the teachers and students have a negative perception of religious diversity; and 4. the project has successfully implemented the peace education based on Islamic values in the four schools.

(1) the PAI curriculum does not have enough content that aims to instill coexistence and peace education, (2) a third of teachers and students reported intolerant attitudes towards other religions, and (3) the development of a peace education based on Islam project was successfully carried out.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of Religious Education, especially Islamic Religious Education (PAI), in promoting peaceful co-existence in a plural society.
the promotion of peace in a plural society through the implementation of a peace education curriculum based on Islamic values.
the development of peace education in Indonesia.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, although the curriculum for Islamic Education in the four selected junior secondary schools in Surakarta City is not yet fully developed to promote religious harmony and peace building, the majority of teachers and students have positive attitudes toward diversity and pluralism.
the PAI curriculum in the four SMP in Surakarta is not yet able to promote the values and attitudes of peaceful coexistence.
, the Islamic religious education curriculum in SMPs in Solo City, is still not able to promote peace, and the majority of teachers and students have negative perceptions of religious diversity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and tested the Peace Education through Islamic Values (PEIV) program in a pilot study.
the curriculum of Islamic Religious Education in Indonesia has the potential to contribute to peace building, but that it has not been used for this purpose.
the curriculum of PAI is still lacking the material which aims to instil coexistence and peace education.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the current PAI curriculum is not designed to promote peace, and that a substantial portion of the teachers and students have intolerant attitudes toward religious minorities.

, in order to promote tolerance and coexistence in a pluralistic society, it is important that schools teach students to appreciate diversity and to understand that diversity is a source of enrichment.
PAI can be an important instrument for building peace in plural societies.
